# Projet-Final---All-aboard

> Rails 8 peer-tutoring app (**StudyLink**): subject feed, real-time chat, mentors, admin. Rails 8.1 · SQLite3 · Solid Queue/Cache/Cable · Tailwind/Stimulus/Turbo · Devise auth · Docker/Kamal deploy. This repo is the THP final-project artifact (historical reference for All-Aboard).

## Root

- [README.md](README.md): Repository overview — setup, stack, run commands
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent guide — change protocol, stack summary, WorkSpace context
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code-oriented commands and project facts

## App (Rails)

- [app/models/](app/models/): ActiveRecord models — subjects, chats, mentors
- [app/controllers/](app/controllers/): Controllers
- [app/views/](app/views/): Views (Tailwind + Stimulus)
- [app/channels/](app/channels/): Action Cable real-time chat channels
- [app/jobs/](app/jobs/): Background jobs (Solid Queue)
- [app/services/](app/services/): Service objects

## Database

- [db/schema.rb](db/schema.rb): Schema definition
- [db/migrate/](db/migrate/): Migrations
- [db/seeds.rb](db/seeds.rb): Seed data

## Config & deploy

- [config/routes.rb](config/routes.rb): Route definitions
- [Gemfile](Gemfile): Ruby dependencies
- [Dockerfile](Dockerfile): Container build
- [.kamal/](.kamal/): Kamal deployment config

## Optional

- [test/](test/): Test suite (Rails tests)
- [package.json](package.json): JavaScript dependencies
